newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Food processor Chundu applies to offer B shares.
newsitem.headline: Food processor Chundu applies to offer B shares.

text.p: Henan-based Chundu Group Co Ltd has submitted an application to the China Securities Regulatory Commission to offer 150 million B shares and list them in Shanghai, a company spokesman said on Friday.

A main domestic underwriter and international coordinator have yet to be chosen for the B share offer, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin. He declined to give further details of the issue.
Chundu, based in Luoyang city in central China's Henan province, makes food products such as sausages, he said.
Chundu has total share capital of 205 million legal person, or institutional, shares, he said.
It is forecasting 1996 after-tax profits of about 90 million yuan, compared with 60 million in 1995, roughly the same as in 1994, he said. The figures are not audited, he added.
